highlights.title: AI Audit Evidence Platform
highlights.description: Built an automated audit-evidence platform (Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, RAG Pipelines, React, Kubernetes) after mapping internal and external audit requirements across 10+ stakeholder workflows. The system indexes repository code alongside Git diffs, database state, and ServiceNow (SNOW) tickets to assemble first-draft audit evidence in 5 minutes instead of 2 days (99% reduction). Selected as a Top-3 Finalist in JPMC’s firmwide Market Excellence Program (MXP) and demoed to leadership for adoption across multiple lines of business.

highlights.title: Core Trade & Risk Management Platform
highlights.description: Drove key serialization and feed-processing changes in a team-led re-architecture of Python and Apache Avro equity trade pipelines using high-throughput pub/sub messaging (AMPS), reactive dependency-graph computation, and distributed object storage. Eliminated schema-serialization bottlenecks and hardened feed delivery across 3 regions (EMEA, AMER, and APAC), helping achieve 5x the throughput of the previous platform while supporting $50M+ in daily equity derivatives and stock trading volume.

highlights.title: High-Throughput Risk & Regulatory Reporting
highlights.description: Cut end-to-end execution times for daily regulatory and risk reporting pipelines by 98% (from 2 hours down to 2 minutes). Replaced sequential, I/O-heavy data transformations with vectorized NumPy and Pandas computation, read-through caching, and Python multiprocessing.

highlights.title: Cloud Data Lakehouse & Orchestration
highlights.description: Designed and shipped an event-driven cloud data lakehouse on Amazon S3 consolidating multi-regional equity and derivatives transaction feeds (300K+ rows/day). Configured AWS SQS-triggered Apache Spark (AWS Glue) ETL jobs writing into partitioned, ACID-compliant Apache Iceberg (Parquet) tables to eliminate full-bucket scans and speed up downstream analytical queries.

highlights.title: Trade Lifecycle Telemetry & STP Scoring
highlights.description: Led the equity derivatives engineering workstream for a firmwide straight-through processing (STP) initiative. Built a production monitoring and scoring engine that flags manual trade touchpoints across bookings and amendments, grading internal platforms on automated vs. manual processing percentages and establishing a manual-touchpoint benchmark to prioritize future engineering roadmaps.

highlights.title: Agentic Operations Diagnostics Platform
highlights.description: Developed an internal diagnostics platform for middle-office operations using Python, FastAPI, Tornado, LangGraph, React, and TypeScript. Connected a multi-step tool-calling state graph and MCP integrations across 16 backend diagnostic APIs and an incrementally indexed AST codebase RAG pipeline so operations teams can investigate blocked trades without escalating to engineering.
